self_agreement_cell_contrast_fisher_exac.note: The statistic the body cites for 'this is not decoding stability'. Both sides measure the SAME thing -- the model reproducing its own six-item ordering across repeated calls -- so unlike cell_contrast_fisher_exact_one_sided it compares like with like. Denominator is repeated keys parseable in BOTH runs, so conflict is 79, not 80: one key failed to parse in one of the two runs.

note: noise_floor.json's exact_agreement_rate is gold-rank agreement (equality of 1/rank(gold)), NOT equality of the six-item permutation. full_ordering_exact_agreement here is the permutation-level quantity.
